description.name: FeatureDesk - Smart Spec Box & Plan Matrix for WHMCS
description.tagline: Transform cluttered pricing cards into clean hero highlights with a synchronized bottom technical specifications comparison matrix
description.long: FeatureDesk is an ultra-modern WHMCS addon module by Bahari IT that declutters your hosting order forms. Instead of stuffing 20+ lines of technical specs into tall, messy pricing cards, FeatureDesk displays 3-5 clean highlight badges on the card and automatically renders an interactive, categorized Technical Specifications Matrix right below your plans.
features: Product Edit Page integration: Configure card highlights and extended specs directly inside WHMCS Setup -> Products
Interactive comparison matrix rendered below pricing tables on cart / order forms
Clean, modern UI dashboard for managing all product specifications across product groups
Preset feature templates for cPanel Web Hosting, NVMe Turbo Hosting, Cloud VPS, and Dedicated Servers
Category-based tech specs (Hardware, Storage, Email & Domain limits, Performance & Security)
Interactive 'View Full Tech Specs' smooth scroll button on pricing cards
100% responsive, dark-mode ready, zero dependency modern CSS/JS architecture
